chunks.arabic_text: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ حَجَّ وَ لَا يَدْرِي وَ لَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ ثُمَّ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِمَعْرِفَتِهِ وَ الدَّيْنُونَةِ بِهِ أَ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ

translations.en: I wrote to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام asking him about a man who performed hajj while he did not know and did not recognize this matter; then Allah bestowed upon him its recognition and adherence to it. Is the hajj of Islam still upon him?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ قَدْ قَضَى فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ الْحَجُّ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "He has fulfilled the obligation of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and hajj is more beloved to me."

en.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on a person who performed hajj before recognizing the true matter and then later came to know and adhere to it. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that the obligation has been fulfilled, though repeating hajj is more beloved.
en.seo_question: If someone performed hajj before recognizing the truth and then later gained correct belief, must he perform Hajj al-Islam again?

key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرَ: this matter, i.e. the recognized religious truth in context
